# Agent team (Anthropic)

An agent team in Claude Code is several full sessions under a team lead, each an [agent][industry.agent] in its own right that the others interact with ([Claude Code glossary][a3]). Its members are therefore not [subagents][industry.subagent], which interact only with the agent that started them; the two are related, not the same.
